verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page directly claims the product can "Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks," which is a first-party scheduling capability. That is the only mention, and nothing documents how schedules are created, whether they recur (cron-style or intervals), or what jobs they can run. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of scheduled workflows, explicit evidence of recurring (not one-off) schedules, configuration details such as cron or interval syntax, run history or monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
